d: Recruiting on behalf of: A leading training center

Talent Diamond is recruiting an experienced English Language and Business English Trainer on behalf of a leading training center based in Jeddah. The trainer will support adult learners and company employees in improving their English for professional and workplace use.

Programs may include general English, business vocabulary, professional email writing, report writing, meetings, telephone and video-call communication, presentations, and workplace conversation. The trainer should be able to assess learners' levels and tailor lessons to their goals, whether they are improving everyday communication or preparing for work-related responsibilities.

Requirements: Strong English proficiency; experience teaching adults or workplace English; ability to plan structured lessons and assess progress; and engaging classroom or online facilitation skills. A relevant teaching qualification and experience teaching multilingual learners are preferred. Arabic language ability is an advantage.
Trainers worldwide are welcome. Please state your location, delivery languages, and availability for in-person delivery in Jeddah, online delivery, or both.
Benefits: Medical insurance and annual flight tickets for self and family, plus an annual discretionary bonus/incentive

d: Welcome to the award-winning five-star Mövenpick Hotel Bahrain, located adjacent to Bahrain International Airport, with a magnificent view of the sprawling lagoon and less than 10 minutes away from downtown city centre of Manama, the capital of Kingdom of Bahrain.

The hotel offers 97 luxury hotel rooms and 10 suites with state-of-art facilities and amenities. Our 5 star hotel went through a complete transformation; including restaurants and bars as well as rooms and suites.

Silk's restaurant is all day dining, offering international cuisine and theme nights. Gallery lounge is located in the high ceiling natural light glass lobby, serving French pastries, high tea and Swiss Mövenpick coffee and delights. While Xenia bar and lounge is offering exotic cocktails and bar food with live night entertainment daily. Mövenpick Hotel Bahrain is well known for its award-winning Friday Brunch.

The award-winning European Rimal spa, features 12 treatment rooms, including single treatment suites, one double female suite and two traditional Turkish hammam suites with their own steam rooms and heated wet tables. Rimal Spa is the only spa that offers non-surgical CACI Synergy machines in the Kingdom. All treatment rooms are designed to the highest standards and have private showers.

Mövenpick Hotel Bahrain is a place to experience world-class luxury hospitality, blended with Arabian tradition and a touch of Swiss that makes our guests feel at home in one of the most attractive and friendly destinations in the Gulf Region.
